line: Bitcoin drifting higher on extreme fear and oversold technicals, while ETF outflows collide with whale accumulation and short liquidations in a divided market.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +0.31% on the day, spot ETF net -231.4M USD (Nov 24, 2026), Fear & Greed 13 (extreme fear), funding +0.0100% per 8h (warm)

wire_top3.line: Sens. Warren and Van Hollen sent letters to SEC Chair demanding rescission of the innovation exemption and Regulation Crypto.
Switzerland approved 57 countries and territories for automatic crypto tax information sharing starting 2028.
Ukraine parliament passed crypto regulation and tax bill establishing 18% plus 5% military levy, effective July 2027.
